AN238
Natures, Cultures, Environments
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
will explore anthropological and related approaches to the study of humans and their material surroundings. Topics will be addressed such as cross-cultural perspectives on human-animal-plant relations, landscape perception, natural resource conflicts, environmental activism, climate change, and the anthropocene.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
Exclusions
